result.reason: The search request sends the sensitive API credential to Brave beyond the stipulated local boundary without requiring explicit prior consent.
The summary request sends the sensitive search API credential to Brave without requiring explicit prior consent; selecting summary=true does not establish that consent.
The autosuggestion request sends the selected sensitive environment credential to Brave without requiring explicit prior consent.
The spellcheck request sends the selected sensitive spellcheck or search credential to Brave without requiring explicit prior consent.
Both answer paths send the sensitive Answers API credential to Brave without requiring explicit prior consent.
